body:
Announces the trial results, naming Sombra, Carmen and Adgrim as the leading graduates.

Recorded role and choices

In the 31 August 2024 graduation, Alvis places Sombra first, Carmen second and Adgrim third, while congratulating the whole group. When Adgrim doubts his result, Alvis affirms it. The scene establishes his part in the apprenticeship quest without supplying an unrecorded institutional rank.
